senses.zh_definition: Lennie：英语人名，常作 Leonard 的昵称，也可用于女性；在马来语文本中作为人名使用。
senses.en_definition: Lennie: an English personal name, commonly a diminutive of Leonard and also used as a feminine name.
senses.ms_definition: Lennie ialah nama orang dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya nama timangan bagi Leonard dan juga digunakan sebagai nama perempuan.
senses.nuances: 此处为专有名词，正常书写为 Lennie，不具有已经核实的马来语普通词义。以上马来语释义为编辑性说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。不能据此断定每位名为 Lennie 的人正式姓名都是 Leonard。以下搭配为自然的人名结构，未验证其搭配频率。[姓名来源与用法](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lennie)

etymology.historical_story: Lennie belongs to an English naming tradition in which a familiar form can become an established personal name. It is recorded as a diminutive of Leonard and can also be feminine. In Malay discourse, it functions as a person’s name rather than a newly derived Malay word. Its ending should therefore not be interpreted as a Malay suffix. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lennie)
